Ana R: Heads-up: several interviewer calendar invites bounced today. Hiring manager reported missing confirmations for EMEA candidates.
Tom B: Which requisition/cohort?
Ana R: Multiple panels across EMEA interviews — about 7 interviewers across teams.
Sasha V: Any ATS errors?
HR-ops-bot: [13:02] ATS export failed to create calendar events: 7 event rejects - invalid attendee address or encoding error
Ana R: I downloaded the raw export. It looks fine at first glance, but some interviewer names have accented characters and one file had a leading BOM. The calendar service seems to reject attendees when the CSV encoding is weird.
Tom B: Ah, BOM + non-NFC unicode can trip our calendar parser. We normalize names to NFC and expect UTF-8 without BOM.
Sasha V: Can we do a quick transform to strip BOM and normalize unicode then re-run the invite job?
Tom B: Yes. I'll add a sanitizer step: strip BOM if present, run NFC normalization, and ensure header names match `interviewer_email` exactly (case-sensitive). Also add a fallback to match by ATS user_id if email parsing fails.
Ana R: Timeline? Interviews start in 18 hours.
Tom B: 30 minutes to deploy the sanitizer and requeue the affected export. I'll also add an audit log showing which rows had modified names/emails.
RecruitingBot: [13:15] export flagged: file=emea-interviewers-2026-03-23.csv, encoding=UTF-8 with BOM, 5 rows contained combining characters
Sasha V: I'll re-export and drop into the backfill queue once Tom's patch is live.
HR-ops-bot: [13:28] sanitizer deployed to prod. backfill job queued: job-id=bf-2156789012-1
HR-ops-bot: [13:40] backfill bf-2156789012-1 finished: 7 invites retried, 6 delivered, 1 pending (manual confirm required for external attendee)
Ana R: Confirmed 6 interviewers now show as accepted in calendars. One external vendor needs manual confirmation; recruiter is on it.
Tom B: Follow-ups: added unit tests for BOM and NFC normalization, and a pre-import check that rejects non-UTF-8 or BOM encodings with a helpful Slack message to recruiting.
Sasha V: Also adding a short note to Recruiting Ops runbook: ensure ATS export uses UTF-8 (no BOM) and include ATS user_id column for robust matching.
Ana R: Thanks team, big relief. Could we add a monitor that tracks calendar invite failure rate >1% over 1h?
Tom B: Will add a Datadog alert to #people-ops for invite rejection spikes.
Sasha V: Closing loop and will update hiring managers. :thumbsup:
